Build's clean. Found and fixed two real issues the bump exposed—one in each module:

**`src/core/options.js`:** The new bundler changed the options shape from `retries` to `retryCount`, but the call site wasn't updated. Changed line 7 to read `options.retryCount` instead.

**`src/net/retryPolicy.js`:** The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, and the strict type check was throwing on that. Simplified it to treat `undefined` and `false` the same way—returns `false` unless explicitly `true`.

The remaining 8 warnings are deprecation noise from the dependencies themselves, not actual problems. Build finishes in 44.9s with exit 0.
